title: Substitution of magnesium towards stabilizing low-nickel layered oxides for high voltage and cost-effective sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,981-990
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01730G, Paper
Yongliang Ma, Haihan Zhang, Liang Xie, Weibo Hua, Zhengxin Huang, Xiaohui Sun, Jintian Luo, Chengyong Shu, Kang Yang, Wei Tang
The NMNFM obtained by Mg doping through NNFM exhibits a high reversible capacity of 153 mAh g−1 at 0.1C, with excellent capacity retention after 100 cycles, achieving a capacity retention rate of 82.1%.
